Neighbouring 'ZLATAR' / 'ZLATAR JUVELIR' jeweller, 'MAIN SQUARE' souvenir shop and 'Panetterie' signs are distractors; 'YOU LOOK HUNGRY' is window slogan.

k1340982149.notes: Small blue Zagreb street-name plate on a corner building, seen through a windscreen across a crossing; two lines of tiny explanatory text under the name are illegible. The large 'Koracell / SANITARIJE / VODOMATERIJAL' shop signs are distractors (could also be a business-sign target). House number 5 plate at the right.

p070dd83726.notes: Brown bilingual tourist finger signs in Zagreb, all cut off on the left by the frame: Museum of Hangovers (Muzej mamurluka), Rock 'n' Roll Museum (Muzej Rock... Vala Zagreb), Ban Jelačić Square (Trg bana J. Jelačića), video-game history museum (Muzej povijesti videoigara). Only the visible parts are transcribed; '...' marks the cut. Dolac market stalls in the background.

p667d292c9b.notes: Large bronze letters across the Gradska štedionica (City Savings Bank) building on Ban Jelačić Square, Zagreb. The leading 'G' is cut by the left frame edge and the Š is partly behind a lamp post (caron visible). Smaller 'GRADSKA KAVANA' and 'Zagrebačka banka' lettering, 'MARTIMEX', 'CHANEL' and 'VISITOR CENTER' signs are distractors.

peae5628f53.notes: Jewellery shop in Zagreb: a projecting box 'Lapidarium / AUTORSKI NAKIT' and two black fascia panels 'Lapidarium' in a stylised lowercase font. The centre board lists 'hrvatski autorski nakit / croatian author jewelry', 'personalizirani nakit / custom jewelry', 'nakit ručne izrade / exclusive handmade jewelry', 'www.lapidarium.eu'. Painted shutters are distractors.

p2d3d98646d.notes: Orange Müller drugstore logo with its M flower emblem on Ban Jelačić Square, Zagreb; house number 8 plate by the left door. DIOR and VALENTINO window posters and photo-print window graphics are distractors.
